cnn_target_layer_rule: For R04/R06/R07 implementations, select the last torch.nn.Conv2d leaf module whose forward output on the frozen 256x256 input path is 4D with both spatial dimensions > 1. Resolve and record the exact module path before reading XAI results; use the same path for all three seeds of an architecture.
heatmap_processing: compute Grad-CAM++ at the frozen target-layer representation
normalize each map to [0,1] using its own finite min/max; constant maps are recorded as degenerate

qualitative_panels.may_add_error_panel: A separate error panel may use a prospectively specified rule (lowest-confidence incorrect predictions, deterministic tie-break) and must be labeled post-prediction diagnostic.
qualitative_panels.rule: Generate a fixed reproducible panel after quantitative computation: 12 images chosen from the 240-sample set by deterministic hash, not by visual attractiveness.

quantitative_faithfulness.masking: replace selected pixels with the per-image RGB mean computed after EXIF correction/RGB conversion and before CTC normalization
quantitative_faithfulness.metric: saliency-guided deletion confidence drop relative to matched random deletion
outputs: mean probability after matched random deletion
architecture/seed mean and bootstrap-free descriptive distribution summaries
quantitative_faithfulness.random_control: 10 deterministic matched-area random masks per image/fraction seeded from SHA256(stable_row_id || model_run_id || fraction || control_index)

sample_selection.rule: exactly two rows per class, chosen independently of prediction outcome by ascending SHA256(stable_row_id || '|TRACKA-A1-XAI-V1') within each class

sanity_checks: classifier-head randomization sanity check on a deterministic 30-image subset; compare normalized-map Spearman correlation before/after randomization
horizontal-flip consistency on a deterministic 30-image subset using inverse-flipped heatmap comparison
scientific_role: supporting explainability, shortcut-detection and faithfulness audit; not a lesion-segmentation or agronomic-causality experiment
selection_role: XAI is completed before the final Track-A model-selection gate but has no weighted ranking term. It is reported as supporting trustworthiness evidence and may trigger a transparent methodological warning, not silent model switching.
target_class: the model's top-1 predicted class for quantitative faithfulness; ground-truth class maps may be generated only as clearly labeled secondary diagnostics

qualification_before_outputs: instantiate the exact frozen timm model and resolve model.blocks[-1].in_norm; if that exact module path is absent, fail closed rather than substitute another target after seeing XAI outputs
record model.num_prefix_tokens and model.patch_embed.grid_size from the exact qualified model
require a square patch grid of 16x16 at the frozen 256x256 input and patch16 configuration
require the target activation to be a 3D token tensor [B,N,C] and N - num_prefix_tokens == 256
transformer_target_rule.reshape_transform: drop the first model.num_prefix_tokens tokens, reshape the remaining 256 patch tokens to [B,16,16,C], then permute to [B,C,16,16] before Grad-CAM++
transformer_target_rule.reason: token-aware late semantic representation; do not use the patch-embedding convolution as a surrogate late feature map

forbidden_claims: higher visual appeal means better model
XAI result may be used to add/tune architectures, seeds, losses or corruption severities
